articles.title: Brooks Koepka reveals how Tiger Woods looked on the range recently as his return is announced
articles.summary: Brooks Koepka and Wyndham Clark have shared their reaction to the news that Tiger Woods will make his return to competitive golf at next month’s Hero World Challenge. It was announced on Tuesday that Woods has taken up one of the final three spots in the event that he hosts in the Bahamas, with Rickie Fowler and Gary Woodland completing the field at Albany.
